column1: #   soul        : canonical lowercase Soul key (e.g. shinobi, kagemusha, astromancer)
#   id          : vanilla FFXI resource ID (spell 0..1023, weaponskill 0..511, ability 512..2047)
#   icon_id     : optional classic icon ID (0..65534, or 65535 to keep vanilla)
#   icon_id_v2  : optional HD icon ID (0..65534, or 65535 to keep vanilla)
# Editing this file and running /soulactions reload updates native menus immediately without rebuilding crystaljobs.dll.

column5: Strike one enemy with light. Costs 8% max MP. 6s recast.
Burn one enemy with concentrated light. Costs 12% max MP. 8s recast.
Smite one enemy with a pillar of light. Costs 16% max MP. 12s recast.
Commit to a heavy light strike against one enemy. Costs 20% max MP, 22% at Lv.70 with increased power. 14s recast.
Empower your next damaging Zealot spell by 20%. Lasts up to 20s. 90s recast.
Strike one enemy with a lance of light. Costs 15 MP. 15s recast.
Designate yourself or one nearby party member for escort. 5s recast.
After enemy damage interrupts your Wingmate, protect one retry of the same spell within 6s. MP refund scales with level. 25s recast.
Summon 2 offensive shadow clones against your engaged enemy (max 5 active, 25-30s, zero defensive shadows). 20s recast.
Summon 3 offensive shadow clones against your engaged enemy (max 5 active, 25-30s, zero defensive shadows). 30s recast.
Squad feint strike that creates a 12s Opening (+25% potency or +2s duration on your next different squad command). Advances tactical phase. 12s recast.
Shifts living shadows into an alternating fast/heavy attack rhythm for 10s, scaling with squad size (2-5 clones). Advances tactical phase. 16s recast.
Orders surviving shadows to execute rapid staggered single-target physical strikes against your engaged enemy. Advances or triggers Cascade. 14s recast.
Locks living shadows onto your engaged enemy for 12s (+ACC/+melee, refreshes focus, extends active phase +4s). No enemy debuff. 18s recast.
High-tempo escalating sequential strikes across living shadows (requires 2+ clones for full relay chain). Advances or triggers Cascade. 22s recast.
High-commitment single-target finisher scaling with living clones (1-5) and consuming your active tactical phase for peak burst. 45s recast.
Every living shadow launches one staggered single-target physical strike at your engaged enemy. Integrates with Opening and tactical phases. 90s recast.
Reduces living shadows' native autoattack interval by 25% for 8s while preserving staggered attack timing. Integrates with tactical phases. 30s recast.
